summary.what_it_does: The page is a blog index of essays by ICMD Editorial on technology, startups and AI for founders and operators. Articles cover topics such as making model outputs auditable and grounded, managing prompt edits and model swaps, LLM control planes with evals, tracing, routing and policy, and tool-calling agents with access control. Each entry lists a title, short summary and reading time (roughly 7 to 9 minutes). The page also includes a newsletter sign-up for weekly essays. The only product-like claim is a listing in jaywcjlove/awesome-mac describing iCMD as a global fuzzy menu search tool with Vim-style navigation; the page text itself does not describe that app's features, platforms or pricing.
notable: Essay series on verifiable and auditable AI systems for startups
